beats.say: Ankit Gupta used coding agents to program an AWS F2 FPGA to run an LLM bit-exactly, then let an autoresearch loop push throughput from 6.43 to 213 tokens per second, 33x the baseline.
Most of the C++ and Verilog was written by agents; the loop ran hundreds of experiments, wrote about 3M lines across its history and cost about $10,000 in Claude and OpenAI tokens.
The final f2.6xlarge image beat an exact 32-core Zen 5 CPU twin by 1.65x at a similar hourly price.
